title: Part time Payroll Specialist
description:
Part-Time Payroll Specialist
Location: Didsbury, South Manchester
Hours: 25-30 hours per week over 5 days
Salary: Up to £35,000 FTE, plus bonus
Working pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in office, 2 days WFH

Client Details

In this role, you'll be responsible for coordinating the full UK payroll process. You'll play a key role in ensuring payroll is accurate, compliant and delivered on time, working closely with HR, Finance and external payroll providers.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of payroll operations, maintaining strong controls and identifying opportunities to improve processes. With part-time hours and a flexible hybrid working approach, we recognise the importance of finding the right balance between work and life outside the office.

Description

The key responsibilities of a Part time Payroll Specialist will be:
- Manage the end-to-end monthly UK payroll process, including data preparation, calculations, employee payments, payslips and statutory submissions.
- Ensure all payroll activities comply with UK legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance, RTI reporting, statutory payments and workplace pension obligations.
- Oversee outsourced payroll processing across four international countries, ensuring accurate data, timely approvals, appropriate funding and compliance with local regulations.
- Complete payroll reconciliations and investigate variances, providing accurate payroll data and insights to support the Finance team.
- Partner with HR to manage employee lifecycle changes, including new starters, leavers, salary adjustments, contractual changes, absences and benefits.
- Maintain effective payroll controls and accurate records, ensuring clear audit trails, appropriate documentation and robust approval processes across UK and international payrolls.
- Coordinate payroll year-end processes, support audits and system updates, and manage relationships with external payroll providers.
- Review existing payroll processes and implement improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency and overall service delivery.
- Act as a key point of contact for payroll queries, resolving issues promptly and providing clear, reliable support to employees and internal stakeholders.

Profile

A successful Part time Payroll Specialist will have:
- Previous experience managing or coordinating an in-house UK payroll.
- Good knowledge of UK payroll legislation, including HMRC and pension requirements.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines effectively.
- Experience working collaboratively with Finance, HR and external payroll providers.
- The ability to investigate and resolve payroll queries confidently.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

Job Offer
- Salary: Up to £35,000 FTE, pro rata + bonus
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home
- Pension: Salary sacrifice scheme.
- Life assurance
- Enhanced sick pay: Company sick pay scheme.
- Private medical insurance: Single cover, with option to add family.
- Annual leave: 25 days plus bank holidays.
- Extra holiday: Option to buy up to 10 additional days.
- Additional paid leave for key occasions.
- Birthday day off.
- Enhanced parental leave
- Free on-site parking

title: Credit Controller
description:
An exciting opportunity awaits you with a leading organisation, as they search for an enthusiastic Credit Controller to join their vibrant finance team in Altrincham!

This is your chance to become a key player in safeguarding cash flow, maintaining impeccable sales ledger records, and ensuring timely invoicing, all while thriving in a truly supportive and knowledgeable environment. You'll be surrounded by colleagues who value inclusivity, offer flexible working options, and provide ongoing training to help you shine and grow. If you're eager to make a real impact, build strong relationships with retail customers, and see your attention to detail and teamwork celebrated every day, this role is tailor-made for you.

Step into a collaborative finance department where your expertise will be at the heart of business success - protecting cash flow and supporting commercial operations with every action you take.

Enjoy flexible working opportunities and continuous training that empower you to develop professionally while maintaining a healthy work-life balance, so you can flourish both inside and outside the office.

Work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in an inclusive environment that values your input, encourages growth leadership, and supports your personal development through every stage of your career journey.

Responsibilities:

Raise and issue accurate sales invoices and credit notes based on customer purchase orders, delivery documentation, and agreed pricing, ensuring all transactions are processed swiftly and efficiently.

Check invoices for accuracy before despatch, collaborating with sales, warehouse, or customer teams to resolve any discrepancies quickly so clients receive flawless documentation.

Support the transition towards automation by partnering with IT and other departments to facilitate EDI implementation, helping streamline processes for greater efficiency.

Maintain precise sales ledger records by correctly coding and allocating all transactions, guaranteeing data integrity across the board.

Proactively manage a portfolio of customer accounts by chasing outstanding debt via phone, email, and customer portals within agreed credit terms to keep cash flow strong.

Produce regular aged debt reports on a weekly or monthly basis, identifying overdue balances early and escalating risk accounts as needed to protect financial stability.

Build effective working relationships with customer accounts payable teams to resolve payment delays and queries promptly, fostering trust and collaboration.

Monitor customer credit limits closely, flagging accounts approaching or exceeding thresholds while working with management on credit risk decisions for optimal outcomes.

Allocate incoming customer remittances against invoices accurately and promptly to support timely cash collection and seamless reconciliation.

Prepare debtor reporting and commentary for the Finance Manager, highlighting trends, risks, and cash collection forecasts that inform strategic decision-making.

Experience Needed:

Proven experience in a sales ledger, credit control, or accounts receivable role within a B2 B/wholesale or manufacturing environment

Experience dealing with large retail customers - including familiarity with portals, EDI systems, and retailer-specific documentation

Working knowledge of credit control best practices as well as aged debt management techniques is essential for delivering results in this role.

Confident use of accounting or ERP systems combined with proficiency in Excel (including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP functions and pivot tables)

Strong numerical accuracy paired with exceptional attention to detail empowers you to maintain precise records even under pressure.

Professional communication skills allow you to chase payments diplomatically while resolving queries collaboratively with customers

Excellent organisational abilities equip you to manage high volumes of transactions

What sets this company apart:

This organisation truly stands out thanks to its unwavering commitment to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member's contributions are celebrated! Flexible working arrangements mean you can balance professional ambitions with personal wellbeing- making it easier than ever to thrive both at work and at home. Training opportunities abound so you can expand your skillset while advancing your career within a supportive environment led by knowledgeable professionals who champion growth leadership. Collaboration is at the heart of everything here: everyone works together towards common goals - whether it's improving processes through automation or resolving complex queries across departments. The culture prioritises teamwork over hierarchy; ideas are welcomed from all levels so you can make meaningful impact regardless of your position. With generous pension contributions available alongside ongoing development initiatives tailored specifically for finance professionals like yourself, this is the perfect place for those seeking long-term career satisfaction within a respected industry leader.
